description: Interpreting a list of the shared literals as a propositional disjunction gives the same satisfaction relation as its finite set of members.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Resolution.list_clause.{u} {α : Type u} [DecidableEq α]
  (v : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Valuation α) (L : List (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PropLiteral α)) :
  Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.eval v (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.clauseFormula L) = true ↔
    Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Resolution.ClauseSat v L.toFinset
